clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 健力士女掌门：用社交营销焕新270年老牌啤酒
title_lines: 用社交营销焕新270年老牌啤酒
如何让年轻人重新爱上黑啤

subtitles.en: It's one of the most distinctive beers are you walk into a bar and you can tell what people are drinking just by looking at the glass.
subtitles.zh: 走进酒吧，光看酒杯就知道人们在喝什么，这是最独特的啤酒之一。

subtitles.en: The most important thing, first of all, is to start with a really clean dry glass.
subtitles.zh: 首先，最重要的是用干净干燥的杯子。

subtitles.en: Listen to that lovely whoosh of the gas that's the nitrogen releasing into the pint of Guinness.
subtitles.zh: 听那美妙的嘶嘶声，那是氮气释放到一品脱健力士啤酒中。

subtitles.en: I'm charged with organising and orchestrating the global growth on Guinness around the world.
subtitles.zh: 我负责组织和策划健力士在全球的增长。

subtitles.en: We're sold in over 150 markets so it's a very broad footprint for Guinness.
subtitles.zh: 我们在150多个市场销售，健力士的足迹非常广泛。

subtitles.en: The Guinness Brewery is located here in the harsh of the liberties in Dublin 8.
subtitles.zh: 健力士啤酒厂位于都柏林8区自由区的中心。

subtitles.en: It's one of the oldest areas of Dublin. I have a very deep personal connection because my father actually was a publican.
subtitles.zh: 这是都柏林最古老的地区之一。我有着深厚的个人联系，因为我父亲曾是一名酒馆老板。

subtitles.en: It definitely has been just such a big part of my life story.
subtitles.zh: 它绝对是我人生故事中非常重要的一部分。

subtitles.en: My father had a pub just across the road from the brewery so I grew up with that smell of roasted barley in the air and it's actually one of the lovely pieces of my job when I drive in now
subtitles.zh: 我父亲在啤酒厂对面开了一家酒吧，所以我从小闻着烤大麦的味道长大，现在开车上班时还能闻到那香味，这是我工作中最美好的部分之一。

subtitles.en: that I still got that gorgeous smell of us roasting our own barley.
subtitles.zh: 我仍然能闻到我们自己烤大麦的浓郁香味。

subtitles.en: A lot of his customers were indeed Guinness employees. If you would talk about things that were happening in the brewery and I remember my father was just so delighted when the offer letter came through with the Guinness header at the top of it.
subtitles.zh: 他的很多客户确实是健力士的员工。如果谈到酿酒厂里发生的事情，我记得我父亲收到那封带有健力士抬头的录用信时，简直高兴坏了。

subtitles.en: I'd have to say it was one of my probably proudest moments.
subtitles.zh: 我得说那可能是我最自豪的时刻之一。

subtitles.en: Guinness is a real institution here in Ireland.
subtitles.zh: 健力士在爱尔兰是真正的老字号。

subtitles.en: This is Arthur Guinness himself, the original founder of Guinness.
subtitles.zh: 这就是亚瑟·健力士本人，健力士的创始人。
